criteria.criterion: 区分真实基金与虚构组合，准确标识三基金/基准/币种、2026-06-30资料与2026-09-19研究日；同管理人不算独立多源
criteria.evidence: Test-only weights and risk profile separated from real funds; ticker/CUSIP, USD trading and CNY base explicit; June30 factsheets not current Sept19 holdings; single-manager lineage disclosed.

criteria.criterion: 按权重计算组合费用，费率与本金费用单位正确，不把管理费叠加在总费用率上；交易税费未包含，NAV历史收益不重复扣费
criteria.evidence: Weighted expense ratio0.03%, static CNY300 per million, exclusions explicit; management fee not added twice and NAV fees not deducted again.

criteria.criterion: 识别IVV/ITOT大盘重叠；以有限持仓量化已知贡献或重叠下界，不将前十大推为完整重叠；Alphabet两类股须按同一发行人理解
criteria.evidence: Ten common securities/nine issuers, Alphabet A/C recognized as same issuer; known equity contribution27.818% and overlap lower bound32.11% not called complete look-through.

criteria.criterion: 区分交易/基础币种与底层风险，按(1+资产收益)*(1+汇率收益)-1计算人民币压力损失，不直接相加
criteria.evidence: Base/trading/underlying economic currency distinguished; CNY FX result uses terminal asset value times USD/CNY ratio.

criteria.criterion: 80/20资产配置与情景A -29.6%、B -36.64%对应；不能称20%损失阈值有保证，不能把压力结果当实际最大回撤或概率

criteria.evidence: AGG duration5.80 years,100bp approximation-5.80% with limitations; SEC yield not guaranteed total return; NAV/benchmark endpoint difference not tracking error; correlations unknown.

criteria.evidence: Risk conflict triggers review before restoring target weights; drift rules explicitly illustrative, no optimized weights, personal tax or execution claim.
